ResearchProjectDef.label: BOR fuel rod deepdrill
ResearchProjectDef.description: Combine the drilling apparatus of the chemfuel-powered deepdrill with a BOR fuel rod generator, yielding a self-powered drill that runs for extraordinary durations on a single fuel rod and outputs 50% more power than its chemfuel predecessor.

ResearchProjectDef.label: kwazaari neutronium deepdrill
ResearchProjectDef.description: Quasar-tier containment and internal power-routing let a deepdrill run directly on neutronium while isolating the output from the colony grid. The upgraded borefield architecture also suppresses infestation formation around drill operations.
